title: Nonnegative heads in the folding simulator
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a finite alphabet with decidable equality, and let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over $\Gamma$. For every input over the folded alphabet, every number of steps $t\in\mathbb{N}$, and every work tape of $M$, the corresponding work-head position in the folding simulator's run from its initial configuration is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: finite Turing machine M over Γ
replaced:
For every multi-tape machine $M$ over a finite alphabet with decidable equality,
the folding simulator of $M$ has nonnegative heads: for every input over the folded
alphabet, every number of steps, and every work tape, the position of that tape's
head in the corresponding initialized run is nonnegative.
